title: Coffee, Tea, Milk, and Sugar
label: ch:it-coffee-tea-milk-sugar
canDo: I can ask for coffee, tea, milk and sugar in Italian, and tell which of the four were borrowed and which was inherited.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson gathers il caffè, il tè, il latte and lo zucchero, meets lo on a real noun for the first time since Chapter 1 stated the rule, and sorts all four by history: caffè from Turkish, tè from Chinese, zucchero from Arabic by a different road than caffè, and latte alone never borrowed at all.
